title: Back in San Francisco: Turk Murphy, record business, George Lewis
summary: After New York he played briefly with Turk Murphy, settled into wholesale jazz records, and played with George Lewis in 1957.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: and then back out to San Francisco I played for a short while with the Turk Murphy band and then he went on the road for a long period and I had a I had by the time I had a wife and a fairly newborn child and so I wanted to put down a root so I did I stayed there and worked in the record business wholesale records luckily jazz records so I could do a meaningful job in selling that kind of material I was able to play with the George Lewis band for a few weeks in 1957 as I recall his trumpet player at the time was Thomas Jefferson and for some reason he wanted to come running home to New Orleans which he did very abruptly
